note: Artifacts too large for git. Fetch with scripts/fetch_models.py. The calibration files committed in models/ (gop_reference.json, word_duration_stats.json) are measurements of THIS acoustic model's behaviour and are wrong for any other -- see acoustic_model_sha256. vowel_classifier.joblib additionally requires the wav2vec2 checkpoint; without it the engine disables vowel-identity checking rather than failing.

models/yoruba_acoustic.zip.purpose: MFA acoustic model. Everything else is calibrated against it.

models/vowel_classifier.joblib.purpose: Vowel identity classifier. Needs the wav2vec2 checkpoint at models/lyngual-yoruba (1.26 GB, fetched separately per INSTALL.md) -- it consumes learned features, not measurements.

models/tone_classifier.joblib.purpose: Tone classifier, trained on this aligner's boundaries.

models/lyngual-yoruba/model.safetensors.purpose: wav2vec2 checkpoint the vowel classifier reads its features from (LyngualLabs/mms-300m-yoruba-english, layer 16). Without it the engine disables vowel-identity checking.
